title: 第一卷 第2421章 你给自己惹麻烦了第一卷 第2422章 萧雨还是狂的
content_zh:
阴阳庙，就在那边了吧。
林辰等人站在一处废墟之上，透过前方的迷雾，眺望远方。
这地方人迹罕至。
因为清楚是夏侯家的核心据地所在，谁也不想在千神洞府与夏侯家相争，未免意外，触动夏侯家的敏感神经，干脆不往这边来了。
林辰他们是少数朝这边前行之人。
而这路上，自然免不了有夏侯家的哨探，各种探测类的阵法也是比比皆是，的确被夏侯家经营的如同铁桶一般。
外人想要悄无声息的靠近都难。
以林辰亦或者骆雨棠的能耐，自然可以避开这些哨探以及阵法，可以不被察觉的接近阴阳庙。
不过没有这样做的必要。
林辰是应邀而来，是合作者，不是来虎口夺食的。
而远处，那阴阳庙矗立，相较于此前见到的纸庙与轮回庙，这阴阳庙要显得宏伟许多。
这不像是一座庙，倒像是一座殿堂了！
“据说，当年在神名殿堂之中，阴阳庙祝是最强的庙祝，没有之一，曾有能力竞争神名殿主之位！”骆雨棠道。
也难怪阴阳庙如此雄伟。
“夏侯家用了如此漫长的时间在千神洞府布局，耗费人力物力可说是天文数字，但至今依旧没能突破阴阳庙，可见此地的惊天动地！”林辰道。
阴阳庙的阻碍，难以跨越，即便是林辰到来，其实也不说有把握能够通过这里。
“你跟叶蓁合作，可得小心些”，骆雨棠掩嘴轻笑。
眼神有些促狭，耐人寻味。
“前辈不要乱想”，林辰咳了一声。
不过以叶蓁过往的行事风格来看，与之合作，的确是要冒风险的，她可不是一个喜欢共享利益的主。

林辰，自然心中存着警惕。
“前辈，你看这阴阳庙，是不是有些奇怪，气象卷向苍穹，给人的感觉可不好”，林辰蹙眉道，他感觉心里毛毛的。
骆雨棠耸耸肩，她倒是没有感觉到什么，她之前也并没有来过这里，一切都是听他人转述。
阴阳庙究竟有何等危险，只有去了才知道。
“哼，你跟叶蓁合作，看来叶蓁对你另眼相待啊”，萧雨轻哼一声，的确是胆子肥了，现在都敢阴阳林辰。
“你没事就去找萧家族人吧，现在也没有留你的必要了”，林辰道。
之前挟持萧雨是迫不得已，原本是想着当做俘虏，必要时候还有用，但在纸庙既然已经解开了她身上的捆仙绳，而且当初对苏苏使用捆仙绳的，也并非萧家天神。
林辰也便不想跟她计较。
萧雨闻言，顿时一怔。
林辰竟然让她走？
沦为阶下囚的时候，萧雨恨不得要将林辰生吞活剥，想象着脱困之后，直接让林辰生不如死。
被捆仙绳锁困，她无时无刻不想脱困。
只是后来，她摆正心态，以及最终重塑自信之后，想法却改变了不少，心里面也没有那么愤怒仇怨了。
此刻竟然一下子不想离开。
“哼，走到这里，也有我一份力，什么意思，现在是想要卸磨杀驴了是吗？”萧雨冷哼一声。
这话，让大家都是微微侧目。
萧雨嘴角抖了抖，也知道自己说的有些扯淡了，但这会儿是比拼定力的时候，当下就是硬着头皮，没有再说什么。
这在之前，萧雨是绝对干不出来的。
俗称脸都不要了。
但现在，她能撑住。

这应该就是成长，是挫折带来的变化，家族耗费天量资源也绝对堆不出来的。
content_en:
The Yin Yang Temple is right over there.
Lin Chen and others stood on a ruins, looking into the distance through the fog in front of them.
This place is deserted.
Because it is clear that this is the core base of the Xiahou family, no one wants to fight with the Xiahou family in Qianshen Cave. It would accidentally touch the sensitive nerves of the Xiahou family, so they simply don't come here.
Lin Chen and the others are among the few people heading this way.
On this road, there are naturally sentinels from the Xiahou family, and various detection formations are everywhere. Indeed, the Xiahou family manages them like iron barrels.
It is difficult for outsiders to approach quietly.
With Lin Chen or Luo Yutang's ability, they can naturally avoid these sentries and formations, and approach the Yin Yang Temple without being noticed.
But there is no need to do this.
Lin Chen came here as an invitation, as a collaborator, not to snatch food from the tiger's mouth.
In the distance, the Yin-Yang Temple stands. Compared with the Paper Temple and Samsara Temple seen before, this Yin-Yang Temple is much grander.
This is not like a temple, but more like a palace!
"It is said that in those days, the Yin Yang Temple Zhu was the strongest temple blessing in the Divine Name Hall. No one could compete for the position of the Lord of the Divine Name Palace!" Luo Yutang said.
No wonder the Yin Yang Temple is so majestic.
"The Xiahou family has spent such a long time in setting up the Thousand Gods Cave, spending an astronomical amount of manpower and material resources, but they still haven't been able to break through the Yin Yang Temple, which shows how earth-shattering this place is!" Lin Chen said.
The obstacles of Yin Yang Temple are difficult to overcome. Even if Lin Chen arrives, there is no guarantee that he can pass here.
"You have to be careful when working with Ye Zhen," Luo Yutang covered her mouth and chuckled.
His eyes were narrow and thought-provoking.
"Senior, don't think too much," Lin Chen coughed.
However, judging from Ye Zhen's past behavior, it is indeed risky to cooperate with her. She is not someone who likes to share interests.
Lin Chen was naturally wary.
"Senior, look at this Yin-Yang Temple, isn't it a bit strange? The weather is rolling up to the sky, which gives people a bad feeling." Lin Chen frowned, feeling uncomfortable in his heart.
Luo Yutang shrugged. She didn't feel anything at all. She had never been here before. Everything was told by others.
How dangerous the Yin Yang Temple is can only be known if you go there.
"Hmph, you cooperated with Ye Zhen. It seems that Ye Zhen treats you differently." Xiao Yu snorted. He was indeed brave and now dared to yin and yang Lin Chen.
"If you have nothing to do, go find someone from the Xiao family. There is no need to keep you here now," Lin Chen said.
She had no choice but to hold Xiao Yu hostage before. She originally wanted to use her as a prisoner so that she could be useful when necessary. But now that she had untied the fairy rope in the Paper Temple, and the one who used the fairy rope on Su Su was not the Xiao family god.
Lin Chen didn't want to argue with her.
Xiao Yu was startled when he heard this.
Lin Chen actually let her go?
When he was a prisoner, Xiao Yu wanted to eat Lin Chen alive, imagining that after escaping from the trap, Lin Chen's life would be worse than death.
Trapped by the immortal rope, she never wanted to escape.
But later, after she corrected her mentality and finally regained her confidence, her thoughts changed a lot, and she was no longer so angry and resentful in her heart.
At this moment, I didn't even want to leave.
"Humph, I have contributed to getting here. What do you mean, now you want to kill the donkey, right?" Xiao Yu snorted coldly.
These words made everyone look slightly sideways.
The corner of Xiao Yu's mouth trembled, and he knew that what he said was a bit nonsense, but this was the time to compete for concentration, so he just bit the bullet and said nothing more.
Xiao Yu would never have been able to do this before.
Commonly known as "no face left."
But now, she can hold on.
This should be growth, a change brought about by setbacks. The family will never be able to accumulate it even if it spends a lot of resources.
